assets.name: pastel-red-pedestrian.png
assets.prompt: Recolor this walking pedestrian-sign pictogram to a slightly darker muted pastel red, color #C66B6B. Preserve exactly its simple geometric walking pose, detached round head, proportions and framing. Use a perfectly uniform flat solid fill, crisp smooth edges. The only subject must be the silhouette: REMOVE all stray pixels/specks/fringe outside its boundary and between the arms/legs/head. All surrounding background and gaps must be genuinely transparent (alpha zero). No outlines, texture, gradient, shading, shadows, letters, sign board, background or extra objects. Output a transparent PNG of this single clean colored pedestrian.
